entries.title: Luau Roblox LocalScript Fly Architecture
entries.content: Use Players.LocalPlayer, UserInputService, RunService.RenderStepped, Workspace.CurrentCamera, LinearVelocity (fallback BodyVelocity), and AlignOrientation. Clean connections on CharacterAdded/Humanoid.Died.

entries.title: Python Typed Calculator with ZeroDivisionError Guard
entries.content: Define typed functions add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, handle ZeroDivisionError and ValueError cleanly, include assert self-tests in __main__.

entries.title: TypeScript Express REST API Pattern
entries.content: Use express.Router / express(), strict TypeScript interfaces, input validation helper, CRUD Map/store, HTTP 201/400/404 status codes, and /health endpoint.

entries.title: Android Jetpack Compose / Activity Complete Structure
entries.content: Include settings.gradle.kts, build.gradle.kts, app/build.gradle.kts, AndroidManifest.xml, MainActivity.kt with setContent/UI state, strings.xml, and architecture README.md.

entries.title: Modern C++17 CLI Application Pattern
entries.content: Include <iostream>, <vector>, <string>, <stdexcept>, RAII class encapsulation, command parsing loop/flags, and deterministic test assertions.

entries.title: PHP 8 PDO Prepared Statement CRUD Pattern
entries.content: Use <?php declare(strict_types=1);, PDO SQLite/MySQL with ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, prepared statements against SQL injection, and JSON HTTP response helpers.

entries.title: Go Idiomatic File Reader with bufio.Scanner
entries.content: Use package main, os.Open, defer file.Close(), bufio.NewScanner, line statistics, and explicit error returns.
